findings.title: No certificate pinning anywhere in the app
findings.claim: The base APK ships a network_security_config.xml with no <pin-set> element at any level, and no alternative pinning mechanism is reachable from the manifest.
findings.impact: Any party who can install a user CA (MDM, malware with device-admin, or a compromised CA) can transparently intercept the app's HTTPS session, including the gRPC payment channel.
findings.recommendation: Pin the payment hosts (sapi, qrpay, token, oauth.zaloapp.com) with backup pins, or adopt Play Integrity-bound key pinning.

findings.title: Application-wide cleartext HTTP is permitted
findings.claim: base-config sets cleartextTrafficPermitted="true", so any http:// URL the H5/mini-app layer emits will be followed without a TLS upgrade.
findings.impact: Vendored Alipay 'a.alipayobjects.com' / 'activityservice.alibaba.com' JavaScript and the cleartext HTML help pages can be loaded over plain HTTP, letting a network attacker inject script into a WebView that shares the app's cookie jar.
findings.recommendation: Set cleartextTrafficPermitted="false" and keep an explicit allow-list only where a partner bank's 3-D Secure ACS forces it.

findings.title: Clipboard OTP harvesting across 15 Vietnamese banks
findings.claim: The app enables a clipboard parser that matches one-time-passwords from 15 bank SMS templates plus ZaloPay's own six-digit pattern.
findings.impact: Because *any* process on the device can write the clipboard, a malicious app can seed a valid-looking OTP and induce the wallet to autofill it; conversely the feature means the app regularly reads the shared clipboard, a privacy-sensitive OS surface (Android 12+ shows a toast for every read).
findings.recommendation: Keep the feature but scope it to foreground + explicit user intent, and prefer the SMS Retriever API so the app never touches unrelated clipboard contents.

findings.title: 134 credential-shaped constants embedded in bytecode
findings.claim: Anchored pattern matching over 269,338 unique DEX strings yields 134 secret-shaped constants (112 x 40-char base64, 20 x 32-hex, plus two manifest meta-data keys). Values are withheld; only lengths and SHA-256 prefixes are recorded.

evidence.policy: values are never persisted; only (pattern, length, sha256[:12], prefix[:4])

findings.impact: Any client-embedded key is extractable by definition; a 32-byte value next to AES usage is an encryption key with the same lifetime as the APK.
findings.recommendation: Move all symmetric material to server-side key management; rotate anything that was ever shipped in a client binary.

findings.title: Runtime DEX unpacker in the JNI bootstrap path
findings.claim: libfgcpkjvqe.so exports only JNI_OnLoad/JNI_OnUnload and links mprotect + inflate + AAssetManager_*. It reads a 776,320-byte high-entropy asset (assets/fgcpkjvqe.dat, entropy 7.9998), decompresses it in memory, mprotects the result and hands a DEX to the loader.
findings.impact: Static analysis of the shipped APK sees the loader, not the loaded code. Any reviewer who only reads classes*.dex underestimates the app; the real entry path is native.
findings.recommendation: Publish the packing scheme to reviewers (or drop it) so app-store security review and bug-bounty triage can actually reach the protected code.

findings.title: RSA-2048 public key and an opaque signature blob shipped as assets
findings.claim: assets/public.pem contains an RSA-2048 SubjectPublicKeyInfo (DER 294 B) and assets/config/signature.txt contains a 256-byte signature; assets/config/public_key.txt holds a second, distinct RSA-2048 key.
findings.impact: The signature is a detached signature over some manifest of trusted mini-apps or config. Because verification code is client-side, the trust decision is patchable.
findings.recommendation: Document the signed scope; bind it to a hardware-backed key (Keystore attestation) so a patched client cannot simply return true.

findings.title: Alipay SecurityGuardLite + Baichuan-shielded bundle
findings.claim: Two native libraries (libsecurity_lite.so, libtaibmcf.so) implement Alipay SecurityGuardLite (decryptByAes/encryptByAes/rsa_public_decrypt/aes_cbc_decrypt) and assets/ contains bshield.dat, taibmcf.dat/json and a UUID-named bundle directory — the Baichuan (mPaaS) shielding chain.
findings.impact: The wallet's mini-program substrate is a third-party runtime with its own key hierarchy; a vulnerability in Griver/Ariver/mPaaS becomes a vulnerability in ZaloPay's H5 payments surface.
findings.recommendation: Vendor the runtime with reproducible builds and a published security-contact, and pin its remote bundle versions.

findings.title: 30 exported components, including a host-APDU payment service
findings.claim: The manifest exports 14 activities, 2 activity-aliases, 6 services and 8 receivers. Among them are a NFC HCE service (VisaHostApduService) and the deep-link router ThirdPartyAppActivityAlias that accepts zalopay://pay, ://otp, ://clearing, ://cashier and zalopay.api.v2://auth.
findings.impact: Every exported entry point is reachable by any installed app. The deep-link router performs the dangerous parameter parsing for payments; an intent-redirection bug there is directly monetisable.
findings.recommendation: Validate every deep-link parameter server-side, require a signed nonce for zalopay://pay, and keep the HCE service restricted to the payment AID with per-transaction user verification.

findings.title: Self-signed, non-EV signer; no v3.1/v4 and no source stamp
findings.claim: The APK carries only APK Signature Scheme v2 (one signer block) with a self-signed certificate whose subject and issuer are identical (CN=Vu Manh Hieu). No v1 JAR signature files, no v3.1 rotation, no source stamp.
findings.impact: v2-only means no key-rotation path for the app's lifetime: any future signing-key change must go through a new package name or a Play App Signing rotation.
findings.recommendation: Add v3/v3.1 rotation and a source stamp; keep v1 off (correct) but document the rotation plan.

findings.title: 20 DEX images and 67.9% short identifiers — static review is costly
findings.claim: The corpus contains 20 DEX images, 63,827 classes and 378,040 methods; 43,342 classes (67.9%) have names of two characters or fewer, and 98,429 methods are similarly shortened.
findings.impact: Third-party auditors cannot cheaply establish 'no backdoor' for a binary of this shape; the cost of review is itself a security property.
findings.recommendation: Ship R8 mapping files to the Play Console and to any external auditor under NDA.

findings.title: 373 mini-apps bundled in a wallet-side catalogue
findings.claim: assets/config/miniapp_config.json ships a 883 KB catalogue of 373 mini-apps across 19 Vietnamese categories, each with base_url, one-link and deep-link metadata.
findings.impact: The catalogue is a map of third-party data flows: each base_url receives the user's identity context when the mini-app is opened.
findings.recommendation: Publish a per-mini-app data-sharing notice and keep the catalogue server-driven.

findings.title: 27 native libraries, no arm64-v8a split in this distribution
findings.claim: The APKPure bundle provides only config.armeabi_v7a (32-bit ARM), while targetSdkVersion is 36. 27 .so files ship in that split, of which 9 are ML/vision runtimes.

evidence.abi: armeabi-v7a (32-bit ARM, no arm64-v8a split shipped)

findings.impact: 32-bit-only distribution is a device-fragmentation choice; it also means the native attack surface assessed here does not describe the arm64 build Play serves to most users.
findings.recommendation: Publish the ABI matrix used for store delivery and include arm64 in future audits.

findings.title: 35 gRPC RPC names and 56 config sections are client-visible
findings.claim: assets/config/zalopay_config.json enumerates the wallet's RPC vocabulary (um/*, v001/tpe/*, ummerchant/*, cpscdn/*) and 56 configuration sections including KYC limits and OTP templates.
findings.impact: An attacker does not need to guess the API: names, groups and business limits are shipped in the client, which shortens enumeration of the payment backend.
findings.recommendation: Treat the client config as public and enforce every limit server-side (verify this is the case).

findings.title: 13 Play Feature Delivery modules, including the money-movement surfaces
findings.claim: resources.arsc declares 13 package chunks. The cashier, cash-in, withdraw, bank-binding, PIN reset and liveness flows are dynamic-feature modules resolved at runtime.
findings.impact: Module boundaries reveal the product's true structure: the wallet is a thin shell around a cashier, a credit engine and an eKYC pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Document module boundaries for penetration-test scoping.
